gates.name: Threshold field test
gates.rule: 30-min TT; replaces device LT 167 bpm. All threshold and easy-cap HR values in this plan are rescaled from the measured LTHR.

gates.name: 10K checkpoint 1
gates.rule: <=40:00 -> start specific block as written; slower -> hold volume flat 2 more weeks.

principles: Volume first: build to 80-92 km/week over 6-7 runs and hold >=75 km for 8 weeks (Doherty 2020; Tanda 2011).
Easy means easy: HR cap 140 bpm on every non-quality run until LT1 is measured (Seiler 2010; Stoggl & Sperlich 2014).
Quality as prescribed reps -- stop a threshold rep when HR passes 166.
Strength + plyometrics 2x/week in base and specific, 1x in recovery/taper (Balsalobre-Fernandez 2016).
Recovery weeks every 3-4 weeks are not optional, and run volume is not replaced by extra sessions.
Taper: ~2 weeks, volume -40-60%, intensity and frequency kept (Bosquet 2007).
